statement: DRAM and NAND bit demand growth is expected to exceed bit supply growth by more than 10 percentage points in 2027.
why: A double-digit gap between bit demand and bit supply growth means the memory shortage is forecast to deepen rather than clear next year.

impact.mechanism: Bit supply growing slower than demand forces allocation and price escalation on the memory content inside GPU servers, constraining how many accelerator systems can actually ship.

evidence.excerpt: Bit-based demand growth for DRAM and NAND is expected to exceed supply growth by more than 10 percentage points next year.

confidence.basis: Forward-looking sell-side forecast reported by a single secondary outlet; the stated gap is a floor ('more than 10 percentage points'), not a measured value.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend falling -> falling); sources: Seoul Economic Daily (en.sedaily.com)
